claims: The McDonald's Huntrix Meal launched on March 31, 2026.
The McDonald's Huntrix Meal is also called HUNTR/X Meal.
The McDonald's Huntrix Meal launched as part of the KPop Demon Hunters collaboration.
The McDonald's Huntrix Meal features 10-piece Chicken McNuggets.
The McDonald's Huntrix Meal features a medium drink.
The McDonald's Huntrix Meal features Ramyeon McShaker Fries with soy-garlic-spice seasoning.
The McDonald's Huntrix Meal includes special Demon Sauce.
Demon Sauce is purple-colored.
Demon Sauce is hot tangy mustard.
The McDonald's Huntrix Meal includes Hunter Sauce.
Hunter Sauce is sweet chili.
Ramyeon McShaker Fries are medium fries served with a Ramyeon seasoning mix.
The Ramyeon seasoning mix contains soy, garlic, sesame, and spice.
Ramyeon McShaker Fries are shaken in a bag.
Hunter Sauce is a sweet chili sauce with pepper notes.
Demon Sauce is a bold purple-colored mustard sauce with heat.
The McDonald's Huntrix Meal includes a medium soft drink.
The McDonald's Huntrix Meal includes a collectible card.
The collectible card features the Huntr/X group.
The collectible card has a QR code to unlock exclusive content.
The McDonald's Huntrix Meal is part of an adult meal lineup.
The McDonald's Huntrix Meal is often served with exclusive packaging as part of the KPop Demon Hunters promotional campaign.
10-Piece Chicken McNuggets is the core entree of the McDonald's Huntrix Meal.
